title: Registration via EMYA2027
text: Registration for the Bodensee Symposium runs through the EMYA2027 website. The link below takes you to the registration form as soon as it opens.

fees.price: Early Bird 100 CHF, Late registration 150 CHF
Early Bird 150 CHF, Late Registration 200 CHF

note: Fees will be confirmed when registration opens. Travel and accommodation are not included.
